title: Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued December 19, 2018
主要内容: On December 19, 2018, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note outlining the steps to implement the monetary policy stance announced by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The Board of Governors unanimously voted to raise the interest rate paid on required and excess reserve balances to 2.40 percent, effective December 20, 2018. This rate was set 10 basis points below the top of the target range for the federal funds rate to foster trading within the FOMC's target range. The FOMC also authorized the Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York to execute transactions in the System Open Market Account to maintain the federal funds rate within a target range of 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent. Additionally, the Board approved a 1/4 percentage point increase in the primary credit rate to 3.00 percent, effective December 20, 2018.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
